Smoke test: load baml and parse a simple snippet

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"baml\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("class Person {\n  name string\n  age int\n}\n\nenum Level {\n  Junior\n  Senior\n}\n\nfunction Greet(p: Person) -> string {\n  p.name\n}\n", config);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
